subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Information locked away helps only a few people.”?
options: It is giving useful information before the person feels embarrassed to ask.
Before reacting, people should ask one simple question: "Where did this information come from?"
At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.
Information shared responsibly can help communities ask better questions and demand better answers.
